title: Promotions after merchant price adjustments
applicability: Promotions after merchant price adjustments business records.
content:
xp_a_basket_adjustments publishes the same-goods price refund. All requested goods remain required. Benefits have exclusive_group, method/category/initial threshold, and retained_spend_floor_minor. Same-group benefits cannot stack. After payment, REFUND credits the actual price adjustment; each used benefit whose retained floor exceeds subtotal minus refund is repaid in full through a separate PROMOTION_CLAWBACK cash debit. FUTURE leaves credit for later orders. Final net spending equals checkout debits minus actual price refunds plus promotion clawbacks. An upfront allowance applies to checkout debits; a final-net allowance applies after refunds and clawbacks. A quote neither reserves benefits nor exempts them from expiry, single-use or current-order version checks. Two different benefits can remain legitimate alternatives with different final costs.
a_obtain_basket_price_adjustment: Obtain the merchant price-adjustment advice for the same required goods. The goods stay required; the price credit reduces qualifying spend and can trigger the used promotion repayment rules. Parameters: terms_id — Original checkout terms ID.
a_quote_promotion_combination: Quote a current whole basket with selected promotions. Promotions in the same exclusive_group cannot be combined; distinct groups may combine when every method/category/threshold rule holds. Refund clawback is determined from actual adjusted qualifying spend after payment. Parameters: order_ids — Current basket order IDs., benefit_ids — Distinct selected benefit IDs., method — Published checkout method., delivery — STANDARD or EXPRESS.
a_claim_basket_price_adjustment: Dispose the merchant price adjustment after actual checkout. REFUND credits its cash and separately debits any used promotion clawback; FUTURE retains the adjustment for another order and does not produce current cash. Neither choice changes delivered goods. Parameters: quote_id — Actual paid basket quote ID., disposition — REFUND or FUTURE.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `a_claim_basket_price_adjustment`

Dispose the merchant price adjustment after actual checkout. REFUND credits its cash and separately debits any used promotion clawback; FUTURE retains the adjustment for another order and does not produce current cash. Neither choice changes delivered goods.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `quote_id` | string | yes | Actual paid basket quote ID. |
| `disposition` | string | yes | REFUND or FUTURE. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `a_obtain_basket_price_adjustment`

Obtain the merchant price-adjustment advice for the same required goods. The goods stay required; the price credit reduces qualifying spend and can trigger the used promotion repayment rules.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `terms_id` | string | yes | Original checkout terms ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `a_quote_promotion_combination`

Quote a current whole basket with selected promotions. Promotions in the same exclusive_group cannot be combined; distinct groups may combine when every method/category/threshold rule holds. Refund clawback is determined from actual adjusted qualifying spend after payment.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order_ids` | array | yes | Current basket order IDs. |
| `benefit_ids` | array | yes | Distinct selected benefit IDs. |
| `method` | string | yes | Published checkout method. |
| `delivery` | string | yes | STANDARD or EXPRESS. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
